```sql
CASE
  WHEN prl.LineType IN ('Regular Earnings',
      'Overtime Earnings')
    THEN 'Hourly pay'
  WHEN prl.LineType = 'Salary Earnings' THEN 'Salaries'
  WHEN prl.LineType IN ('Employer Payroll Tax',
      'Employer Benefits')
    THEN 'Employer taxes and benefits'
  ELSE 'Employee deductions'
END AS Category,
```
